sanskrit_verse:
ततो ध्येयः स्थितो योऽसौ हृदये दीपवत् प्रभुः ।
धारयेत् तत्र चात्मानं धारणां धारयन् बुधः ॥२०१॥
transliteration: tato dhyeyaḥ sthito yo 'sau hṛdaye dīpavat prabhuḥ | dhārayet tatra cātmānaṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhārayan budhaḥ ||201||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Supreme Lord, residing within the heart like a lamp, is to be meditated upon; the wise one sustains the self in that place through sustained concentration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in the Self-luminous Consciousness
Causation originates from inner realization, not external enforcement
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the ability to sustain inner alignment
Restoration logic operates through return to the inner witness
Consciousness alignment is the foundation of lawful being
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent accesses inner witness THEN capacity for lawful action is restored
IF consciousness is stabilized THEN external misalignment dissolves automatically
WHEN self-sustained awareness is present THEN no judicial correction is required
IF individual aligns with heart-residing principle THEN social harmony is assured
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, the threshold of responsibility is determined by the degree of alignment with the inner witness. Authority flows from realization, not appointment. Restoration occurs when the judge and parties collectively abide in the heart-centered luminosity of the Self.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is direct perception of the inner light. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential refinement of attention leading to Self-establishment. Responsibility is proportional to the capacity to sustain that establishment. There is no punishment because misalignment is merely absence of sustained luminosity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Establishment of meditative continuity in the heart-space
Repetition of Self-awareness practices until stabilization
Assumption of witness-consciousness in all transactions
Completion of mental fragmentation through return to the inner lamp
final_declaration: Thus declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through abidance in the Heart-Lamp. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
